pre_command:
osascript -e 'tell application "System Settings" to quit' && sleep 2 && osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to try
set loginItemsList to login items
repeat with anItem in loginItemsList
if name of anItem contains "Calculator" then
delete anItem
return true
end if
end repeat
return true
on error
return false
end try'
instruction: Add the 'Calculator' application to the list of items that automatically open when the user logs in.
evaluator:
osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to try
set loginItems to name of login items
repeat with anItem in loginItems
if anItem contains "Calculator" then
return true
end if
end repeat
return false
on error
return false
end try'
